title: monitoring.md's coord.py store and asks sections move whole into coordination.md, with pointers left behind

def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
f = 'kb/_self/monitoring.md'
cur = pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
if '## The coord.py store' in cur.splitlines():
    old, src = cur, 'worktree'
else:
    c = git('log', '-1', '--format=%H', '-S', '## The coord.py store', '--', f).strip()
    assert c, 'no commit removed the coord.py store heading'
    src = c + '^'
    old = git('show', src + ':' + f)
def sec(t, h):
    return t.split('\n' + h + '\n', 1)[1].split('\n## ', 1)[0] if '\n' + h + '\n' in t else ''
body = sec(old, '## The coord.py store') + sec(old, '## Asks and remediation')
assert body, f'sections not found at {src}'
terms = sorted(set(re.findall(r'`([^`\n]+)`', body)))
assert pathlib.Path('kb/_self/coordination.md').is_file(), 'kb/_self/coordination.md missing'
new = pathlib.Path('kb/_self/coordination.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
lost = [x for x in terms if x not in new]
assert not lost, f'{len(lost)} of {len(terms)} terms of the moved sections (at {src[:10]}) are not in coordination.md: {lost[:15]}'
print('ok', len(terms), 'terms kept from', src[:10])
